_doc: Cited, reversible PARTICIPATION overrides (mail 052). One entry = one player in one match whose feed line is contradicted by the school's official full report. Applied at row level by nameclean.apply_identity_override (the one row-override point) in every ingestion path: sets -> the stated value, the feed's value kept as gp_src, a 'participation_corrected' label added. The raw log is never rewritten. Zero-action lines are NEVER changed without such a report (zero actions are not proof of non-participation).

overrides.label: school-report-corrected participation

evidence.text: Louisiana box lists 11 participants: 0 Armstrong, 4 Henry, 5 Smith, 6 Ervin, 9 Miciotto, 10 Sweeney, 11 Williams, 12 Garis, 17 Gaston, 18 Gustafson, 21 Schnell. Five set-starting lineups (LA: 4 Henry; 6 Ervin; 10 Sweeney; 11 Williams; 12 Garis; 17 Gaston; libero 18 Gustafson; set 5 with 5 Smith). Team totals 60 K / 25 E / 173 TA / 56 A / 68 D equal the NCAA feed exactly.

overrides.why: The NCAA feed lists all 17 dressed Louisiana players with gp=5; the official box lists 11 participants. Lambert (zero actions in the feed) is in no box line, no set-starting lineup and no substitution line. The report records no libero exchanges at all, which does not bear on an outside hitter.
